niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency—what’s best depends on your goals, budget, target audience, desired platforms, and whether you need creative, data/measurement, programmatic buying, or full-service TV+digital integration. Below I’ll give a short shortlist of highly regarded agencies and platforms, plus a practical checklist so you can pick the right partner for your needs.

Shortlist of well-regarded CTV partners (strengths)
- Large holding-group media shops (for scale + cross-channel integration)
  - GroupM / WPP (media agencies within GroupM)
  - Omnicom Media Group (OMG)
  - Publicis Media
  - Dentsu
  Strengths: scale, negotiated access to premium inventory, cross-platform planning and measurement, enterprise-level reporting.

- Specialist advanced/connected TV agencies and platforms
  - The Trade Desk (DSP) — market-leading programmatic buying across CTV (used by agencies and in-house teams; not an agency itself)
  - Cadent — addressable/advanced TV planning and activation
  - Simulmedia — advanced TV/linear+CTV optimization and audience targeting
  - Tremor Video / Tremor DSP — programmatic video/CTV buying
  - Amobee — end-to-end ad tech for TV + digital buying and data
  - Roku / Roku OneView — platform-first buying for Roku inventory (managed services + self-serve)
  - Innovid — creative/ad serving and measurement for CTV video ads
  - Magnite / SpotX — supply-side and publisher relationships for premium CTV inventory
  - Samba TV — measurement, attribution and audience insights for CTV

How to choose the right partner (quick checklist)
1. Campaign objective: brand awareness, reach/frequency, awareness + consideration lift, OR direct response/sales-driven? (Different partners excel at different objectives.)
2. Inventory & platforms: Do you need Roku, Samsung, LG, Vizio, publisher apps, game consoles, or cross-platform reach?
3. Buying approach: programmatic DSP vs. premium direct deals vs. platform-managed buys (Roku, Samsung). Do you need preferred deals or open exchange?
4. Targeting approach: household/IP-address deterministic, household graph, probabilistic, or people-based? Do you have your own first-party data for onboarding?
5. Measurement & attribution: For brand lift, sales lift, incrementality, view-through conversions and third-party verification — which measurement partners are supported?
6. Creative services: Do you need CTV-specific creative, dynamic/interactive creative (pause cards, overlays), or just repurposed linear spots?
7. Transparency & fees: Ask about media fees, tech stack fees, data costs, and reporting transparency.
8. Compliance & brand safety: Verification, fraud prevention, and ad quality standards.
9. Reporting cadence & KPIs: What dashboards and KPIs will you get, frequency of updates?
10. Case studies & vertical experience: Relevant brand/category experience and ROI examples.

Key questions to ask agencies/providers
- Where will my ads run (platforms, publishers, device types)? Can you guarantee or prioritize premium inventory?
- What targeting methods do you use and how is audience quality validated?
- What measurement partners do you use (brand lift, incrementality, attribution)? Can you run an A/B test or holdout for incrementality?
- How do you handle frequency capping and dayparting on CTV?
- What are your fee structures and any pass-through costs?
- Show recent case studies for my vertical and budget range.

KPIs to prioritize (by objective)
- Brand awareness/upper funnel: reach, unique households, frequency, unaided/ aided brand lift
- Consideration: engagement time, brand lift, site visits
- Direct response/sales: VTR/completed views, post-view conversions, incremental sales, CPA/CPL (with incrementality testing)

Typical fits
- If you need large-scale cross-platform TV + digital integration: choose a major holding-group media agency (GroupM/OMG/Publicis/Dentsu).
- If you want programmatic control and high-fidelity targeting: look at The Trade Desk (via agency or in-house), Tremor, Amobee.
- If you need platform-specific scale on Roku or Samsung: consider Roku OneView or platform-managed buys.
- If creative, ad serving and measurement are priorities: Innovid (creative/ad-serving), Samba TV or independent measurement providers for lift and attribution.
- If you want addressable/advanced TV expertise: Cadent or Simulmedia.

If you want a tailored recommendation
Tell me your objective (brand vs direct response), approximate monthly or campaign budget, primary geography, and any must-have platforms or data needs. I’ll recommend 2–3 agencies/platforms that would be the best fit and can draft the right RFP questions for you.
